title: HCP1065 population-based tract-to-region connectome (HCP-MMP parcellation)

provenance.extraction: Read cached numeric cells from XLSX XML without executing formulas/macros. Preserve source row/column order and all 9360 values; no thresholding, rounding, interpolation or inferred connectivity.

metric.name: population tract-to-region overlap probability
metric.sampleSizeMeaning: Study cohort size, not a guaranteed per-column denominator.
metric.definition: Published fraction of subjects whose voxel-wise tract mask intersects the cortical region, using the study HCP-MMP volumetric parcellation.
metric.hemisphereSemantics: Each source row is an HCP-MMP region name shared across hemispheres. LEFT columns B:AA refer to the left region and left tract; RIGHT columns AB:BA refer to the right region and right tract. Create separate L_<region> and R_<region> graph nodes when displaying both hemispheres.

limitations: This is a tract-to-region matrix, not a square region-to-region connectome; do not multiply matrices or infer region-to-region edges and label them measured connectivity.
No geometric correspondence between HCP-MMP region IDs and the Z-Anatomy cortical meshes is asserted. Labels from different atlases are not interchangeable.

Cerebellar, commissural, brainstem-to-brainstem, and subcortical-to-subcortical connections are not represented by these cortical-region rows. Corticospinal and corticobulbar cortical associations are present.
The study warns that mask overlap may include a passing tract rather than true innervation and tractography can misroute, terminate prematurely or produce false connections.
Existing HCP1065 tract meshes are educational approximations; semantic selection of them does not validate their cortical endpoints.
missingValuePolicy: All 9360 numeric cells are present. A source zero remains zero; it is not a missing value. The paper masks probabilities below 0.05 only for display. If a UI threshold hides an edge, retain its original value in the data.

sourceDiscrepancies.note: Source spelling mismatch. Do not silently rename or assign a full name; retain raw PTAT. No 3D mapping supplied.
Source abbreviation mismatch. Do not silently rename or assign a full name; retain raw C_R. No 3D mapping supplied.

Most numeric columns are multiples of 1/1065, but numerical checks yield exact integer grids of 1/1056 for left MdLF, 1/1064 for right MdLF, 1/983 for left CBT, 1/1054 for right CBT, and 1/1046 for right AF. These are diagnostics, not supplied participant counts. Never convert probability to counts using cohort size. The paper yield discussion differs from the MdLF headers; preserve source values.
